item.title: UN says US strikes on Iran school that killed over 150 may amount to war crimes
item.description: There are “reasonable grounds” to believe the US committed war crimes against civilians in Iran, who also face “gross human rights violations” from their own government, United Nations investigators said on Thursday. In their latest report, due to be presented to the Human Rights Council on Monday, the independent investigators urged the 47 countries in the council to press for an end to the war, hold those responsible for war crimes to account and give asylum to civilians fleeing... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse

item.title: Mbappé explains decision to cover Ceuta solidarity message
item.description: Mbappé said his decision was not intended as a rejection of Ceuta or its residents. He said he wanted to express solidarity with migrants who have lost their lives and those living in difficult conditions. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: UN experts level explosive war crimes accusation at US over Trump’s Iran strikes

item.title: Directo a... Caracas y la persistencia de violaciones a DD. HH. en Venezuela, según la ONU
item.description: La Misión Internacional Independiente de Determinación de los Hechos sobre Venezuela, de las Naciones Unidas, indicó en su más reciente informe que, pese a los cambios políticos tras la captura de Nicolás Maduro, que redujeron las detenciones prolongadas y las desapariciones forzadas, las violaciones a los derechos humanos persisten porque el aparato represivo del Estado permanece intacto. item.title: English far-right extremist who discussed killing Jews, Muslims and migrants is jailed
item.description: Ivan Jennings, 46, sentenced to five years after pleading guilty to encouraging terrorism on social media A rightwing extremist who discussed poisoning Jews and Muslims and called for the killing of migrants and minority communities has been jailed. Ivan Jennings, 46, called for the murder of hundreds of people he labelled “subhumans”, saying it was “justified and actually needed”, in extreme far-right groups over a period of three months in 2024. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Four years after Mahsa Amini's death, rights groups warn Tehran's crackdown persists
item.description: Human rights groups said those who directed the violent suppression of the 2022 protests still control Iran's security apparatus, as Kurdish businesses shuttered across her home region and the UN Special Rapporteur said four years of state violence had failed to extinguish the resistance. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: Repression continues in Venezuela in the face of ‘appalling’ human rights violations
item.description: In Venezuela’s El Rodeo maximum security prison, some of those detained for political reasons are subject to forced intubation – and prolonged confinement in a sealed underground cistern. Fuente: UN News.

item.title: ¿En qué consiste la reforma judicial propuesta por la presidenta Laura Fernández en Costa Rica?
item.description: La presidenta de Costa Rica, Laura Fernández, impulsa una polémica reforma judicial que ha desatado protestas masivas en defensa de la división de poderes y la democracia. La iniciativa busca limitar los mandatos de los magistrados y recortar presupuesto al Poder Judicial. El politólogo Sergio Araya aborda el tema en France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Salvadoreños en vilo: ¿está en riesgo su futuro en EE. UU.?
item.description: Unos 170.000 viven hoy en medio de la incertidumbre después de que el Gobierno estadounidense decidiera mantener vigente el Estatus de Protección Temporal, pero sin aclarar qué ocurrirá con el programa a largo plazo. Mientras crece el temor a posibles deportaciones, también cambia el panorama en la frontera norte de México, donde los albergues reciben cada vez menos migrantes. En esta emisión les contamos los detalles de la decisión sobre el TPS y, desde el terreno, nos acercamos a la situación humanitaria que viven los migrantes en medio de este escenario de incertidumbre. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Laura Garzón
